toxic.introQuote: "Is my relationship toxic... or am I overreacting?"
toxic.introDesc: If this question keeps coming back, it's never by chance. A toxic relationship is not defined by arguments, but by repeated dynamics that generate fear, guilt, loss of self-esteem, or emotional confusion.
toxic.disclaimer: This test is neither a medical diagnosis nor a judgment.
toxic.disclaimerDesc: It's a lucid self-assessment tool to understand what you're really experiencing.
toxic.testInfo: 25 questions • About 5 minutes • Anonymous and free
toxic.reminderText: This test is purely indicative. It is by no means an exact and precise result, and should not be used to replace professional advice. If you believe your relationship is truly toxic or even dangerous, contact real specialists.

pervers.introQuote: “Am I living with a narcissist… or am I overreacting?”
pervers.introDesc: If this question keeps coming back, it is never by chance. Narcissistic abuse is not recognised by a single argument, but by repeated patterns that install doubt, guilt and a loss of self-esteem.
pervers.disclaimer: This test is neither a diagnosis nor a judgement.
pervers.disclaimerDesc: It is a caring reflection tool to help you put words on what you are really going through.

result.lowDesc: Your answers often differ, and that is not a problem: this test compares your tastes, not how solid your relationship is. Above all, you have plenty left to discover about each other.
result.mediumDesc: You share a good part of your tastes, with just enough differences to keep surprising each other. A very healthy balance.
result.highDesc: Your tastes are remarkably alike. Keep in mind that this percentage measures identical answers, not the strength of your love, which no score can capture.
result.lowAdvice: Take the time to talk through every topic that surprised you.

compat.t1d: Your answers diverge on several fundamentals: plans, pace of life, vision of the future. This is not a verdict on your relationship, it is a map of the topics worth putting on the table. Plenty of solid couples live very well with different visions, as long as they talk about them.
compat.t2d: You meet on a good part of the essentials and diverge on the rest. Spot the questions where your answers did not match: those are exactly the conversations that move a relationship forward.
compat.t3d: You are aligned on the essentials, with a few differences that enrich you rather than set you against each other. This is the most common profile among couples that last.
compat.t4d: Your fundamentals answer each other almost everywhere: values, plans, pace of life. A rare and precious base. Keep in mind that this percentage measures aligned answers, not the strength of your love.

bands.title: A relationship in pain
bands.desc: Your answers describe a relationship that currently hurts more than it helps. It's a hard reading, but it has one virtue: it names what you probably already feel. Talk to someone you trust, and if dialogue has broken down, a couples therapist is exactly what that is for.

bands.title: Foundations to rebuild
bands.desc: Several pillars, communication, trust, repair after conflict, are damaged at the same time. Nothing irreversible, but don't wait for it to fix itself: pick THE subject that hurts most and open it calmly, outside of a fight.

bands.title: A couple looking for its balance
bands.desc: There is a bond, and there are leaks. Your diverging answers show exactly where: those are your priority worksites. The right reflex isn't to fix everything, it's to pick two and truly commit.

bands.title: A real base, known worksites
bands.desc: Your relationship stands on real foundations, with friction zones you probably already know. The difference between couples who progress and the others: the first talk about it before it jams, not after.

bands.title: A solid couple
bands.desc: Communication and trust show up, frictions stay manageable. Your room to grow lies in the subjects you still avoid: that's often where the missing 10 points sleep.

bands.title: A very solid couple
bands.desc: You've built something stable and balanced that rides out storms without taking on water. Maintain what works, and keep an eye on routine: it's the only real threat at this level.

bands.title: A rare couple
bands.desc: Trust, complicity, plans, repair: almost everything is there, and your answers meet where it matters. This kind of balance owes nothing to luck; it shows the work you do for each other daily.

bands.title: An almost perfect match
bands.desc: A score like this is exceptional on one condition: that you each answered with your truth, not the answer that pleases. If so, sincere congratulations. If a doubt remains, take it again playing it straight: the result will only be more beautiful.

quiDeNous.setupDesc: You each vote in secret, then both answers are revealed at once. Time to find out whether you see things the same way…
quiDeNous.passeDesc: No peeking: the vote stays hidden until the reveal.
quiDeNous.accordTexte: You both picked the same person. One more point on the board.
quiDeNous.clashTexte: You don't see this one the same way at all. Talk it out, it's worth it!
quiDeNous.palier1Titre: You really don't see things the same way
quiDeNous.palier1Texte: Each of you has a version, and they barely overlap. That's not a problem at all: it mostly means you have things to tell each other. Go back over the rounds where you disagreed, that's where the best conversations are hiding.
quiDeNous.palier2Titre: One picture out of two in common
quiDeNous.palier2Texte: Half the questions you nail, the other half you miss completely. It's the most common score, and honestly the most interesting one: you know each other, but there are still blind spots. Worth digging into.
quiDeNous.palier3Texte: You see your relationship in roughly the same way, and it shows. The few disagreements left are usually about small everyday things… or about who sings the most out of tune.
quiDeNous.palier4Titre: You think alike, almost suspiciously so
quiDeNous.palier4Texte: You picked the same person on nearly every question. Either you know each other inside out, or one of you peeked over the other's shoulder. We'll let you argue about that one!
quiDeNous.modeTitre: How do you want to play?
quiDeNous.modeDesc: The two ways make for a different game. You can switch between rounds.
quiDeNous.modeSecretTitre: Each votes in secret, then you debate
quiDeNous.modeSecretDesc: You pass the phone, both votes are revealed at the same time, and you talk it out when they clash.
quiDeNous.modeEnsembleTitre: You pick one of you together
quiDeNous.modeEnsembleDesc: No hiding: read the question out loud and name someone by mutual agreement.
quiDeNous.ensembleTexte: One more name on the board.
quiDeNous.passeVerdictTexte: Nobody wanted to call it, and that is fine. On to the next one.
quiDeNous.debatOui: Yes, we agreed in the end
quiDeNous.debatNon: No, we are both digging in
quiDeNous.debatQui: So who is it, in the end?
quiDeNous.debatEchecTexte: You are both sticking to your guns. It happens, and it makes a good story.
quiDeNous.finVerdictEnsemble: Being named the most wins you nothing, except the right to complain about it.

dilemme.introTexte: A hundred deals to take or leave, together. Answer as a couple, then find out what every other couple chose.
dilemme.surTotal1: You are the first couple to decide this one
dilemme.palier1Texte: Almost every deal went straight back where it came from. You know what you are not willing to trade, and that is an answer in itself about what matters to the two of you.
dilemme.palier2Texte: It takes a lot to make you say yes. You weigh the catch before the prize, which spares you a fair few nasty surprises.
dilemme.palier3Texte: You accept the price when the prize is worth it. A good balance between wanting things and thinking them through.
dilemme.palier4Titre: You say yes to almost anything
dilemme.palier4Texte: As long as there is something to gain, you sign. That is a great energy to share, but do read the small print once in a while.
dilemme.bravoTexte: You have answered every single dilemma. Your votes now count towards the percentages the next couples will see.
dilemme.inviteAvisTexte: Having fun? Say so in one second, it helps us enormously.

couche.introQuote: « Has he or she slept with someone else… or am I making this up? »
couche.disclaimer: This test proves nothing and accuses nobody. It puts order into what you have observed, so you know what to do with it.

secret.introQuote: « Do they secretly love me… or am I telling myself a story? »
secret.disclaimer: Think of one specific person before you start, and answer about them only.

distanceAime.introQuote: « Do they still love me… or is it just the distance? »
distanceAime.disclaimer: Answer on the last few weeks, not on the start of your story.

pourContre.introTexte: Sixty statements to settle as a pair. Answer together, then find out how other couples voted.
pourContre.surTotal1: You are the first couple to settle this statement
pourContre.palier1Titre: You say no to almost everything
pourContre.palier1Texte: Nearly every statement went straight back where it came from. You know what you do not want, and that is already a clear answer about the life you feel like living.
pourContre.palier2Texte: It takes a lot to get a yes out of you. You prefer what you already know, which spares you a fair few nasty surprises.
pourContre.palier3Texte: You say yes more often than no, without signing with your eyes shut. A good balance between wanting to try and being practical.
pourContre.palier4Titre: You say yes to almost everything
pourContre.palier4Texte: A pet, a house, a move abroad: you are in. That is lovely energy between two people, as long as you read the small print now and then.
pourContre.bravoTexte: You have settled all sixty statements. Your votes now count towards the percentages the next couples will see.

finCouple.orient_couche_nom: Has he or she slept with someone else?
finCouple.orient_couche_raison: Fifteen questions on the concrete signs, when the doubt is about another person.
finCouple.orient_distance_nom: Long distance: does he or she still love me?
finCouple.orient_distance_raison: You said you live far apart. The signals do not mean the same thing there.
finCouple.orient_toxique_raison: A relationship can end because it fades, or because it damages you. Those are not the same.
